annotations.title: Find Steam games by tags or similarity

description: Discover Steam games by community tags (up to 4, all must apply, e.g. ['cozy','farming']) and/or 'like' a given game (its id → SteamCozy's precomputed similar games). Optional floors on review count and positive %, release year, free only. Results are ordered by how prominently the tags apply, then popularity. Adult-only titles are never returned.

like.description: A Steam app id: return games similar to it (from its SteamCozy page).

released_after.description: Only games released in this year or later.

tags.description: Community tag names (as on Steam), e.g. 'Roguelike', 'Souls-like', 'Cozy', 'Co-op'.

name: find_games

id.description: Steam app id; pass to fetch.

snippet.description: Review score and count, year, top tags.
